headline: Fire Station 2 and Dixwell Avenue grant applications, plus a 3360 Whitney Avenue easement agreement.
summary: A $250,000 planning grant for Dixwell Avenue and a $3.5M grant for Fire Station 2 are on the consent calendar. Other items include a $70,000 special education review and an $18,798.00 Public Works transfer.
items: Referral for executive session in a pending case
Town Attorney budget transfer for fiscal 2026-2027
Police Department agreement with Hamden Public Schools on school security cameras and student information
$70,000 special education review grant for the school board
$250,000 planning grant application for Dixwell Avenue corridor and Fire Station 2 reuse
$3.5M capital grant reapplication for Fire Station 2
State Office of Early Childhood grant funds and contract, July 1 to December 31, 2026
Legislatively directed funds for the warming center and related agreements
Fire Department acceptance of $1,000 Regional Water Authority first responder grant
Police Department 12-month agreement with Daigle Law Group for POST recertification training
$18,798.00 Public Works transfer from Totes to Maintenance budget lines
Amendment to the 2026-2027 budget and transfer for Economic and Community Development
location: Memorial Town Hall, 2372 Whitney Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518 (also on Zoom)

TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
LEGISLATIVE COUNCIL 
 
REGULAR MEETING WORKSHOP & 
OVERFLOW AGENDA 
INCLUDING PUBLIC NOTICE AND AGENDA 
FOR SPECIAL JOINT MEETING OF THE 
COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE 
 
AGENDA 
 
7:00 PM, NOVEMBER 30, 2026 
 
 
Pres. Katie Kiely, At-Large  
Pro Temp. Sean Cardwell, 1st Dist. 
Maj. Ldr. Sarah Gallagher, 4th Dist. 
Min. Ldr. Bob Anthony, At-Large 
Maj. Ldr. Tasha Hunt, At-Large 
Min. Wh. Tom Figlar, At-Large 
Maurine Crouch, At-Large 
Doug Foley, At-Large 
Jeron Alston, 2nd District 
Abdul Osmanu, 3rd District  
Rhonda Caldwell, 5th District 
Grace Teodosio, 6th District  
Adrian Webber, 7th District 
Ted Stevens, 8th District 
Tameeka Parks, 9th District 
 
A HYBRID MEETING OF LEGISLATIVE COUNCIL, INCLUDING A NOTICE OF JOINT COMMITTEE WILL BE 
CONDUCTED: 
IN-PERSON LOCATION: At Memorial Town Hall, 2372 Whitney Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518 
VIRTUALLY: https://zoom.us/j/96032210583 - ID: 960-3221-0583 - Phone (646) 558-8656 
Click for an itemized agenda with supporting documentation: https://hamdenct.portal.civicclerk.com/  
Live comments for this meeting agenda can be heard by joining the meeting in-person or via Zoom. Written 
comments must be sent to LCpublicinput@hamden.com by 3:00 PM on the date of this agenda. 
To participate in public input live or via Zoom — Raise your hand to speak when the public input session is opened. 
You will be called upon in the order that your hand is raised. Once called, you have 3 minutes to speak. You will 
return to the audience at the completion of 3 minutes.   
MEETING CONVENES 
 
  1. Roll Call Updated for committees, Pledge of Allegiance, Moment of Silence and Land 
Acknowledgment, followed by an introduction to the meeting.  
REGULAR AGENDA 
 
  2. Public Input Session 
  3. Correspondence & Communications (A brief Summary will be submitted by CPKK 
during the Council Meeting) This is an information item. 
       a Reports from Departments, Boards, Commissions 
      
  4. LC Communication & Submission Calendar 
  a Communication Submissions 
  b Submissions to be Referred 
  c Committee Referrals-  These items will be referred as soon as information is provided 
and the Mayor's office has signified it's ready for action on the council agenda.  
  I Referral for Executive Session- upcoming item on the horizon 
This is a matter that will need to be voted on by the full Council. It should go to the full 
Council or if a 2 step process is required, the Council as a Committee of the Whole.
The name of the case will be provided prior to any vote by the Committee or Council. 
Attorney Dennis Durao will attend the Executive Session. 
  II Submitted on 11/13/2026 Submission Received by CPKK on 11/20  
Referred to Leadership Agenda on 11/24/26 for discussion and requests for 
additional information. 
ORDER AUTHORIZING INTERDEPARTMENTAL TRANSFER 2026 - 2027 FISCAL 
YEAR BUDGET – TOWN ATTORNEY 
  III Referral for pending agenda action once verification of communication with Council 
board liaison and Hamden BOE has been provided along with necessary documents 
and information to vote on the item. Police Department MOA with Hamden Public 
Schools Regarding Access to School Security cameras and  video surveillance 
systems as well as access to student information on a case by case basis 
         
 IV Special Education Review in the amount of $70,000.00 for the Board of 
Education from the LC Contingency Fund to the BOE as a grant for this 
particular contract and not to be considered in their General Operating 
Budget. Referral to Committee of the Whole Pending documentation from 
the Mayor's office on how to write the transfer will be heard at leadership 
on 12/1 The Clerk is asked to send an invitation to the BOE chair and 
superintendent. 
      
  5. Consent Calendar 
  a Grants & Capital Projects - Order to apply for, accept and expend funds if awarded, 
Round 10 of CT DECD's Community Investment Fund 
- $250,000 planning grant application for community engagement and planning 
studies for improvements to support transit-oriented development along the Dixwell 
Avenue corridor to leverage the forthcoming Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) project. The 
grant application will also include planning for the eventual reuse of Fire Station 2. 
The application is due no later than 12pm on December 4, 2026. 
  b Grants & Capital Projects - Order to apply for, accept and expend funds if awarded, 
Round 10 of CT DECD's Community Investment Fund 
- $3.5M capital grant reapplication for Fire Station 2. The reapplication will include 
project updates since the CIF R9 application. The application is due no later than 
12pm on December 4, 2026. 
  c ORDER APPROVING GRANT FUNDS FROM THE STATE OF CONNECTICUT 
OFFICE OF EARLY CHILDHOOD AND AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR TO SIGN A 
CONTRACT (JULY 1, 2026- DECEMBER 31, 2026) 
  d ORDER TO APPROVE THE ACCEPTANCE OF LEGISLATIVELY DIRECTED 
FUNDS FOR WARMING CENTER AND AUTHORIZATION TO ENTER INTO 
AGREEMENTS 
  e Hamden Fire Department - Acceptance of Regional Water Authority First Responder 
Grant Recipient  
- Hamden has been chosen by RWA to receive $1,000 from their First Responder 
Grant Program as a well-deserved recognition of our commitment to public safety. 
  f Hamden Police Department - Resolution to Enter Into an Agreement with Daigle Law 
Group, LLC 
- 12-month agreement to provide HPD access to the DLG Learning Center's 
Connecticut POST Recertification training program for up to 88 authorized
department users through their online platform.  
 
 
 
  g Order Authorizing Intradepartmental Transfer FY 2026-2027 -Public Works in the 
amount of  $18,798.00 from Totes to Maintenance budget lines.  
  6. Recess for the Special Meeting of the LC Committee of the Whole (No vote is required for this 
action). 
  a Committee of the Whole 
  I ORDER APPROVING AN EASEMENT AGREEMENT 3360 WHITNEY AVENUE 
  II ORDER APPROVING AMENDMENT TO THE 2026-2027 BUDGET AND 
TRANSFER ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT  
RESUMPTION OF REGULAR MEETING AGENDA 
 
  7. Announcement of Changes in Roll Call 
  8. Resumption of the Full Council Meeting and Receipt of Committee Reports and 
Action Items 
  9. New Business  
ADJOURNMENT
